what_happened: Scene layout/style 8 (same faucet as s4, s17, s22). Stage 0: paddle worked 160-207 (close at 166, 0.043), water on at 205 (fast); the spout was dragged to +0.15 meanwhile. Stage 1: 239-273 the gripper pushed the spout head right with the stream visible, to +0.49 (just 0.03 short of 'right'), then left at 273. 300-380 the arm rose and moved right; 380-760 the wrist pointed at the back corner of the counter above/behind the faucet (backsplash, utensil rail) for ~380 steps, with one incidental contact 513-528 that pushed the spout to +0.76 (right washed 485). 766-896 the gripper came back down onto the spout and pushed it slightly further right (+0.85). It never pushed the spout left.
causal_chain: first push right stopped at +0.49 (273) -> left the faucet and hovered looking at the back corner 300-760 -> an incidental contact completed 'right' (485) -> late contact 766-896 pushed right again -> left never washed
official_criterion_notes: Right was credited at 485 from a brief contact while the wrist camera was not looking at the spout.
